title: Altman says OpenAI will keep publishing faster than academia can check
summary: OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman said on the Cheeky Pint podcast that humanity deserves fundamental knowledge and the company should not sit on a major discovery, confirming it holds more unpublished results. He conceded the push had "got out of control" at times. Researchers described the effect to Wired in blunter terms: UC Santa Barbara's Daniel Lokshtanov called it "a giant bomb dropped into the middle of the field", and much of the output remains unpeer-reviewed.
